preconditions.description: Attacker must have DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE or be able to obtain it through privilege escalation
Contract must hold some FIT tokens (from fee accumulation) for the attacker to steal

exploit_hint: As the contract owner (DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE), first set the attacker's address as addressForBosses using setAddressForBosses(). Then call withDraw() to transfer all contract-held FIT tokens to the attacker's address, or call sweepTokenForBosses() to swap tokens for ETH and send to the attacker. Alternatively, grant yourself MINTER_ROLE and mint unlimited tokens to your address, then sell them on Uniswap for profit.
